fab_notes: 1. Material: FR-4 TG155, 1.6 mm, 4 layers, JLCPCB JLC04161H-7628 stackup (sheet 1 table).
2. Copper: 1 oz outer, 0.5 oz inner. Surface finish: lead-free HASL.
3. Solder mask green, silkscreen white, both sides. Vias tented.
4. Fabricate to IPC-6012 Class 2. Electrical test 100 %.
5. Dimensions in mm. Tolerances unless noted: outline ±0.2, finished holes ±0.08.
6. Fabricate from the Gerber and drill files of the same revision as this drawing.
7. Minimum trace width 0.20 mm. Smallest hole Ø0.30 (vias) on Ø0.61 pads: 0.15 mm annular ring.
8. The 4 plated mounting holes are not connected to any net; keep them isolated on all layers.
9. No controlled impedance. No slots, castellations, edge plating or gold fingers.
bom_notes: 1. INSTALLED BY: JLCPCB = fitted by the JLCPCB assemblers (SMT and through-hole) before delivery; After delivery = fitted by the builder.
2. PROCESS gives the assembly process and the side the part is on.
3. U4 (Teensy 4.1, on H1 / H2) and the 7" display panel (on H3) are not on this list; they are fitted at module level, see KC-01-2700.
4. Substitutes need the approval of the design authority.
place_notes: 1. All SMT parts are on the bottom side. H3 (display header) is the only top-side part.
2. The bottom view is drawn as seen holding the board bottom side up (flipped left to right), so the datum is at the top right.
3. Red dot = pin 1 of every part with more than two pins. On D1 the red dot is pin 1, the cathode. These match the silkscreen marks.
4. Part centres, rotations and part numbers are in the placement table (last sheet), measured from the datum (top view).

assy_notes: 1. Item 1 is the KC-01-2702 card as assembled by JLCPCB to KC-01-2701 to KC-01-2704.
2. The Teensy 4.1 (item 5) plugs into H1 and H2 on the bottom of the card; the display (item 4) plugs into H3 on the top.
3. Four standoffs (item 2) join the card and the display, with an M3 screw (item 3) at each end.
4. Orthographic views at 5:4 on A3; isometric views not to scale. Parts list on sheet 2.
